name: Game SFX honour mute, and lazy loop channels do not leak past it
description: Proves the SFX path is healthy and that mute was the discriminator. carol's persisted preference is muted, so her dunk/shot/miss fire at volume 0. This toggles mute off in the lobby before playing; the same sounds must then play at their real base volumes.

steps._comment: Restarts dev server + re-attaches
Fresh app boot as carol
Spy both layers: window.Audio (lazy construction) and HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play (the cloneNode clones makeSound actually plays).
steps.expression: (() => { if (window.__audioSpy) return 'already installed'; const spy = { constructed: [], played: [], settled: [] }; window.__audioSpy = spy; const short = (s) => { try { return String(s||'').split('/').pop().split('?')[0]; } catch (e) { return String(s); } }; const NativeAudio = window.Audio; function SpyAudio(src) { spy.constructed.push(short(src)); return new NativeAudio(src); } SpyAudio.prototype = NativeAudio.prototype; window.Audio = SpyAudio; const nativePlay = HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play; HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play = function () { const name = short(this.currentSrc || this.src || this.getAttribute('src')); spy.played.push({ src: name, volume: Number(this.volume.toFixed(3)) }); let p; try { p = nativePlay.apply(this, arguments); } catch (e) { spy.settled.push({ src: name, status: 'threw', err: String(e && e.name) }); throw e; } if (p && p.then) { p.then(function(){ spy.settled.push({src:name,status:'ok'}); }, function(e){ spy.settled.push({src:name,status:'rejected',err:String(e && e.name)}); }); } return p; }; return 'installed'; })()

steps._comment: DETERMINISTIC: only click when actually muted. A blind toggle flips carol's PERSISTED preference on every run, so the test would alternate muted/unmuted between runs and its result would flip with it.
steps.expression: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); if(!b) return 'no mute btn'; const on = b.getAttribute('data-muted')==='1' || b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true'; if(!on) return 'already unmuted'; b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return 'clicked to unmute'; })()

steps.expression: (() => { const s=window.__audioSpy; if(!s) return 'NO SPY'; const sfx=['swish.wav','dunk.wav','shot.wav','miss.wav','block.wav']; return sfx.map(f=>{const h=s.played.filter(p=>p.src===f); return f.replace('.wav','')+':n='+h.length+',v='+(h.length?h[0].volume:'-');}).join(' '); })()
steps._comment: DECISIVE: the exact sounds the bug names -- ball goes in (swish/shot) and dunk. v=0 means mute was applied to them.

steps.expression: (() => { const s=window.__audioSpy; if(!s) return 'NO SPY'; const m=['game.mp3','title.mp3','dribble.wav','cursor.mp3']; return m.map(f=>{const h=s.played.filter(p=>p.src===f); return f.split('.')[0]+':n='+h.length+',v='+(h.length?h[0].volume:'-');}).join(' '); })()
steps._comment: The lazily-constructed loop channels. Non-zero here while SFX are 0 = mute leaking on exactly the channels whose getters set volume to the BASE constant.

steps.expression: (() => { const s=window.__audioSpy; if(!s) return 'NO SPY'; const bad=s.settled.filter(r=>r.status!=='ok'); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,6).map(r=>r.src+'->'+r.status+':'+r.err).join(' ') : 'all play() promises resolved ok'; })()
steps._comment: NotAllowedError would mean autoplay blocking, a different root cause entirely.

steps.expression: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('#probe-sfx-audible').forEach(n=>n.remove()); const s=window.__audioSpy; if(!s) return 'NO SPY'; const scoring=s.played.filter(p=>['swish.wav','dunk.wav','shot.wav'].indexOf(p.src)>=0); const audible=scoring.filter(p=>p.volume>0); if(scoring.length>0 && audible.length===scoring.length){ const d=document.createElement('div'); d.id='probe-sfx-audible'; document.body.appendChild(d);} return JSON.stringify({scoring:scoring.length,audible:audible.length}); })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION: with mute off, every made-basket SFX played at NON-ZERO volume. This is the regression guard for the lazy-channel mute leak fixed in basketball.js.
